rules.roads: OpenStreetMap roads in Vietnam (fetched in 2026), sampled along their length and snapped to hex-centre links. Class 0: every way mapped as an expressway (highway=motorway, cao tốc; slip roads left out). Class 1: every way mapped as a trunk road (highway=trunk: the national roads, quốc lộ), where no expressway already joins the same two hexes. Each link is named by the route number most of its ways carry (CT.01, QL.1, HCM for the Hồ Chí Minh road). Expressways open to traffic are mapped as motorway; sections under construction are not.
rules.rail: OpenStreetMap railways in Vietnam (railway=rail, fetched in 2026; sidings, yards, tourist and military lines left out), snapped to hex-centre links. Tier 0 (main line): lines tagged as main lines, which include the North–South (Thống Nhất) railway and the lines from Hà Nội to Hải Phòng, Lào Cai, Đồng Đăng and Quan Triều; tier 1: branch and industrial lines. Urban metro lines are not railway=rail and are not drawn.
rules.ports: The 34 seaports (cảng biển) of the Prime Minister's list, Quyết định 804/QĐ-TTg (2022), with its class (special, I, II, III; Decree 76/2021/NĐ-CP). Each seaport is drawn at its main port areas (khu bến) named in the seaport master plan (Quyết định 1579/QĐ-TTg, 2021): two to four for the special and some class I seaports, one for the others. An area is placed at a port, harbour or terminal of that name mapped in OpenStreetMap (fishing ports, ferry landings and marinas excluded), else at a GeoNames or Wikidata port of that name, in or next to the seaport's former province; a seaport none of whose areas is found is placed at the town or commune its main area is named after (GeoNames), and is left out if there is none. Ranked by class, then in the decision's order. Vietnam's port throughput statistics are not published as open data, so ports carry no tonnage.
rules.airports: Every Vietnamese airport with scheduled service and an IATA code (OurAirports), with yearly passengers from Airports Corporation of Vietnam figures compiled on Wikipedia. Hub class by passengers: major 10M+, medium 2–10M, small 0.5–2M, local under 0.5M. Vietnamese names: the title of the airport's Wikipedia tiếng Việt article linked from Wikidata (by IATA code), else its Wikidata Vietnamese label.
